d: The Thunder defeated the Wizards, 114-75 tonight in Oklahoma City. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 9 assists 3 three pointers and 2 rebounds, with Jared McCain of the Thunder adding an additional 19 points (8-10 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. AJ Dybantsa finished with a team-high 19 points along with 6 rebounds for the Wizards in the losing effort. The Thunder improve their record to 8-2 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-6 for the season.
